reuse.why: Delegates the daily-vs-move decision to the shared isDailyWeekendSkip and the move to getDateWithSkippedWeekend, plus recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule; only the occurrence pipeline is composed locally.

duplication.why: The occurrences -> filter daily weekends -> move -> dayFromDate chain repeats getUpcomingDates' pipeline (and getNextDate's) instead of sharing one occurrence-adjustment step.

placement.why: Handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered with its siblings; the shift window constant is local but only this handler needs it.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and typed with RecurConfig, rule decisions come from shared helpers; it drops the captureBreadcrumb error wrapper its sibling uses.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses isDailyWeekendSkip and getDateWithSkippedWeekend rather than re-deciding weekend handling.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated filter/map pipeline is a visible, near-verbatim parallel of getUpcomingDates, not disguised.
